Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing anatomical gift statements when applying for or renewing driver's licenses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to anatomical gift statements; and amending RCW46.20.113.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.20.113 and 1993 c 228 s 18 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of licensing shall provide a statement wherebythe licensee may certify his or her ((willingness)) unwillingness tomake an anatomical gift under RCW 68.50.540((, as now or hereafteramended)). The department shall provide the statement in at least oneof the following ways: (((1))) (a) On each driver's license; or (((2))) (b) With each driver's license; or (((3))) (c) With each inperson driver's license application. (2) A licensee who fails to certify an unwillingness to make ananatomical gift under this section consents to make an anatomical giftunder RCW 68.50.540.
